metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Not targeted despite expanded role
metadata.description: Delp was not targeted during Monday's 45-24 loss versus the Falcons.
metadata.analysis: Delp did record a solo tackle in punt coverage after New Orleans went three-and-out on its first offensive series, but that was his only mark on the stat sheet in Week 4. On a positive note, he was second on the team in snaps at tight end (23) behind veteran Juwan Johnson (53) with Noah Fant (abdomen) sidelined. His involvement in Week 5 versus the Ravens will likely depend on the availability of Fant.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Held to just one catch in Week 2
metadata.description: Delp gathered in his only target for eight yards during Sunday's 24-17 victory over the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: Delp didn't suit up for the 31-30 overtime loss to Detroit in Week 1 due to a hamstring issue, though he was on the field for Sunday's 24-17 upset win over Baltimore. However, despite the rookie's availability in Week 2, he appeared in just nine of the Saints' 68 offensive snaps, catching his only target for eight yards, while logging six snaps on special teams. Although Delp could see more action moving ahead, it doesn't appear as if he will be more involved than Noah Fant and Juwan Johnson anytime soon.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - No injury designation for Week 2
metadata.description: Delp (hamstring) doesn't carry an injury designation ahead of Sunday's game against the Ravens.
metadata.analysis: Delp has been battling a hamstring injury, keeping him off the field for the 31-30 overtime loss to the Lions in Week 1. He was limited during Wednesday and Thursday's practices, though after logging a full session Friday, he now has the green light to suit up for the Week 2 meeting with Baltimore. While it's unknown how much action Delp will see against the Ravens, he could be more involved than Noah Fant behind Juwan Johnson (illness).

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Limited again
metadata.description: Delp (hamstring) was a limited participant in practice for the second straight day Thursday.
metadata.analysis: The tight end has been dealing with the hamstring issue since August and had to miss the Saints' Week 1 loss to the Lions. Delp had to miss practices last week, though, so he is at least trending in the right direction. The third-round pick in April's draft is still trying to make his regular-season NFL debut.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Opens Week 2 prep with limited practice
metadata.description: Delp (hamstring) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Delp has been working through a hamstring injury since late August, which prevented him from playing in the Saints' 31-30 overtime loss to the Lions in Week 1. His return to practice, albeit in a limited capacity, is a good sign, and the rookie third-rounder will have two more chances to log a full session and avoid an injury designation ahead of Sunday's road tilt against the Ravens.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Out for Week 1
metadata.description: Delp (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Lions.
metadata.analysis: Delp didn't practice at all this week after initially suffering the injury last month. The third-round rookie will have to wait to make his regular-season debut. Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant will handle tight-end duties for New Orleans.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp May Open the Year at Bottom of Depth Chart
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints tight end Oscar Delp (hamstring) has modest draft capital as a Day 2 pick, but he may still open the season as the No. 3 option on the depth chart. Juwan Johnson is the undisputed starter at tight end, offering legitimate top-10 upside. Noah Fant is also a candidate to emerge ahead of Delp in the pecking order. While that's far less of a sure thing, it seems somewhat reasonable given Fant's experience as a productive tight end in the NFL. On the other hand, Delp is still just a rookie, and at the moment, he's having trouble even staying on the field. The Georgia product still has some low-end upside in dynasty leagues long-term, but he can be dropped to waivers in all redraft leagues at this point. His path to relevance in 2026 features plenty of obstacles.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp is Ruled Out for Week 1
metadata.description: New Orleans Saints tight end Oscar Delp (hamstring) has been ruled out ahead of Sunday's season opener versus the Detroit Lions. This doesn't come as a surprise, considering Delp hasn't been able to practice at all this week due to a nagging hamstring injury. The third-round rookie has been battling the issue since he sustained it in late August. His professional debut will have to wait at least one more week. Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant will handle the tight end duties during the season opener. Delp is worth a stash in dynasty leagues, but is unlikely to see much of the field while Johnson and Fant are healthy.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Still not practicing Thursday
metadata.description: Delp (hamstring) did not participate at practice Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Delp has been nursing a nagging hamstring injury since late August, and his availability for Week 1 is in serious doubt at this point. Unless he makes a showing at practice Friday, it's not likely he'll play Sunday at Detroit.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Absent on Wednesday
metadata.description: Delp (hamstring) did not participate in Wednesday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Delp likely sustained his injury during the Saints' second preseason game against the Rams. The tight end has not practiced since sustaining the injury and will likely not be capable of suiting up for the Week 1 contest against the Lions. If Delp can quickly increase his practice participation before Friday, he could change his fate, but it seems unlikely as of now.

metadata.title: Oscar Delp - Dealing with hamstring injury
metadata.description: Delp is nursing a hamstring injury at training camp with the Saints, Katherine Terrell of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Delp has caught three of six targets for 10 yards and a touchdown over the Saints' two preseason games this year, though all of that production came in the team's preseason opener. The 23-year-old was selected in the third round of this year's draft, and he's competing with veteran Noah Fant for the top reserve role at tight end behind Juwan Johnson this year. It's unclear what the severity of his injury is, but Delp will have a couple of chances to shake off the injury at practice before Friday's preseason finale versus Dallas.
